summary: Signing out of Classroom and signing back in work properly after an update.
highlights: Sign Out of Classroom now really signs you out, even if you signed in on an older version of Mascot.
After signing out, Sign In to Google Classroom is offered again and works.
When Mascot cannot check your deadlines, the panel says so instead of All clear.
If your school blocks Classroom, the menu now says so instead of saying connected.
If Mascot still says connected after you update, choose Sign Out of Classroom once, then sign in again.
